decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service gained more visibility in 2024 with its own page, it sits close to the core offer and costs little to carry, so the option is still worth holding while demand resolves.
The open GIS framework is still only mentioned and has not been promoted further, so its value remains uncertain, but it fits the firm's open-component strategy and costs little to keep.
The identity service moved from a mention to its own page with a specific integration message, which signals growing commitment in a market where access management for GIS is in demand.
The consulting workshop was launched only in 2024, needs few resources and builds on existing expertise, so its uncertain value justifies keeping it on the market.
